comments.content: The log for a non-processable state reuses the message "File {} is being processed on this server by another table on this server" which is misleading. A state of Processing/Processed/Failed with retries exhausted is not the same as lock contention from another table. Use a distinct message for the state check and avoid logging the same "being processed by another table" line twice.

Compaction loop iterates `for (const auto & object : new_batch)` and then does `std::move(object)`. Moving from a const reference yields a const rvalue, so the unique_ptr cannot be moved and will be copied or fail to compile. Iterate by index or by non-const reference and move the element properly.

LOG_TEST says "Successfully set {} files as processing" with `new_batch.size()` which includes entries that were skipped because prepareSetProcessingRequests returned nullopt. Log `num_successful_objects` instead to avoid misleading metrics.
